acts.name: Arrival
acts.function: Hook: an excited mother sees her daughter's new dorm for the first time; the daughter presents it.

acts.name: The bare room
acts.function: The problem as comedy: a gloomy, empty basement room, polite dismay vs. Gen-Z denial, a dying lamp, a mattress on the floor; ends in dead silence when the lamp and the music die together.

acts.name: The turn
acts.function: One word, said twice ({BRAND}? / {BRAND}.); the music slams back in; the phone comes out.

acts.name: The order
acts.function: Proof of ease: three taps on the app (product, bag, pick up) under the announcer's promise; whip straight to the result being hung on the wall.

acts.name: The reveal
acts.function: Payoff: the same wide, the same camera, now a warm, colourful, finished room; the embarrassing photo; mother's victory knocks.

acts.name: End card
acts.function: The finished room holds under the call to action; logo and URL.

look.grade: Naturalistic commercial-comedy grade. BEFORE (shots 1-9): low-key night, cool grey-green with warm practical pools; brightness 32-56 of 255 (two-shots 39-48, wides 52-56, after the lamp dies 32; the phone shot 67-69 because the screen lifts it). AFTER (shots 10-13): warm afternoon sun, pink-cream, saturated primaries (orange, cobalt, red, yellow); brightness 87-112 (wides 87-90, close inserts 96-112). The jump from ~45 to ~88 at the reveal is the film's biggest visual beat: keep it.
look.contrast: medium; blacks lifted slightly, no crushed shadows; highlights on the screen and window roll off softly
look.light: motivated practicals only; no visible film lights; before = lamp pools and darkness, after = window sun
look.depth_of_field: wides deep; two-shots and inserts shallow (50 mm feel)
look.grain: fine, even 35 mm-like grain; no haze, no bloom, no lens flares

text_style.typeface: clean humanist sans (Noto Sans / Inter feel), semi-bold for the URL line, regular for legal
text_style.size: URL cap height 3.0% of frame height, line 22% of the width; legal cap height 1.3% H in two lines 52% W wide
text_style.position: URL centred at 79% y; legal centred at 91.3% / 93.6% y; logo lockup centred in a 22.9% W x 16.7% H box at frame centre
text_style.animation: URL and legal fade in over 2 frames (0.08 s); the logo follows 0.08 s later with a 3D swing around its vertical axis from edge-on to flat over 4 frames (0.17 s, ease-out); everything holds to the last frame; no outro
text_style.colour: white text, no boxes, a faint soft shadow; the logo is the new brand's own colours

sound.music: One light, bouncy comedic underscore at 145.5 bpm (bar 1.649 s), mixed about 7 dB under the voices (-23.5 LUFS integrated for the stem vs -16.9 for dialogue). M1 0.06-13.26 under the arrival and the bare room; it stops dead on the bar at 13.26 (decays 12.9-13.3) when the lamp dies; 1.5 s of silence holds the joke; M2 re-enters 14.75 with a swell and lands on the downbeat 14.91 with the mother's '{BRAND}.'; it carries the order and the reveal (hit at 20.53) and ends on a button 28.1-28.9, gone by 29.15. Instrumentation was not identified by ear: use the stem set/score.wav for timing and feel.
sound.speech: Twelve lines (set/lines.json): eight on-camera lines of dialogue in the first 22 s (mother and daughter), and two announcer voice-overs (16.11-20.41 and 24.23-29.44). The spot has no dialogue under the end card other than the announcer.
sound.effects: Lamp buzz and ticks on every flicker (6.6, 9.23, 9.75, 9.89, 12.49-12.80); dead room tone in the silence; soft phone taps; hammer: two taps on the frame (20.12, 20.23), knocks 22.36, 22.83, 23.53 (loudest).
sound.mix: Dialogue forward and dry (-15 to -19 LUFS momentary), music bed -24, effects small and real. Total integrated -16.6 LUFS.

ROOM_WIDE.what: THE key setup: the whole room from the corner opposite the door, eye level, 24 mm feel, locked. Only the dressing and the light change.

char_mom.fixes: The mother (invented person, not a likeness): about 52, full-figured, fair skin with freckles, long wavy dark-brown hair, bold black thick-rimmed glasses, big expressive grin. Before outfit: black blazer open over a dusty-mauve tee, gold chain, silver bangles, dark jeans.

char_mom_wardrobe.fixes: Her after outfit (shots 10-13): white shirt with light-blue pinstripes, sleeves rolled, tails knotted at the waist, dark indigo jeans; a steel claw hammer with a black grip in her right hand.

char_daughter.fixes: The daughter (invented person): about 19, slim, fair, long straight dark-brown hair, centre part, no make-up. Before outfit: oversized navy sweatshirt with a mustard-gold laurel crest and the generic word UNIVERSITY, black jeans, white sneakers.

char_daughter_wardrobe.fixes: Her after outfit (shots 11, 13): grey/white/slate-blue plaid flannel open over a moss-green tee, light jeans, high ponytail, red string bracelet.

voice_mom.fixes: The mother's timbre: 7.9 s, all her brand-free lines (the source has no more).

voice_daughter.fixes: The daughter's timbre: 2.7 s (all she says apart from the brand name).

voice_announcer.fixes: The announcer's timbre: 7.6 s of both VO lines without the brand name and URL.

lines.fixes: Every spoken line with word times; brand words muted (slots).

loc_room_before.fixes: The bare basement dorm room, empty, from the ROOM_WIDE camera, at the film's darkness (56): white-painted brick, horizontal window top left, grey water-heater tank far left, mattress on the floor with a dark quilt, old drum lamp on a stool, dark desk, navy crest pennant, doorway at right, boxes and a clothes rail. The master geometry for ROOM_WIDE.

loc_room_after.fixes: The same room from the same camera (made as an edit of loc_room_before), made over: pine bed, striped bedding, red-orange pouf, striped rugs, yellow-white blind and sheer curtains, white desk, pegboard, blue cubby, pink globe lamp, purple heart neon, photo collage, pink door trim, blue armchair; warm sun. The plate renders at 108: grade it down to 87-90 for shots 11 and 13.

loc_doorway_before.fixes: Background of DOOR_ENTRY and TWO_SHOT: the door wall at night, white-painted brick, navy pennant corner, steel door frame and lever handle, dim hallway with shelves beyond, warm lamp glow lower left.

loc_corner_after.fixes: Background of CORNER_MED and PHOTO_INSERT: the window corner of the made-over room, the hung photo on the brick wall, white dresser with the yellow gooseneck lamp, vases and plants on the sill, sheer curtains, pine headboard and striped pillows. Plate at 141: grade to 112.

prop_old_lamp.fixes: The dying lamp: white fabric drum shade on a tall glossy oxblood-red (#5A1E1A) cylindrical base, white cord; lit (warm, uneven) and unlit.

product_desk_lamp.fixes: The ordered desk lamp: round white base, straight white stem, mustard-yellow (#E0A92B) gooseneck in a 180-degree arc, small white cylindrical head, yellow cord. On the app's product page and on the dresser in shot 12.

product_room_set.fixes: The made-over room's range: pine slatted bed, white/pale-blue (#A9C6D8) wide-stripe duvet, burnt-orange (#E2582B)/pink striped sheet set, cushions (white, orange, cobalt #1F4FA8, red #C8202F), grey knit throw with fringe, red-orange tufted pouf, red-and-white striped rug.

prop_photo.fixes: The embarrassing photo: portrait-orientation black frame with a wide white mat, a cheesy studio portrait of mother and daughter back to back in matching light-blue denim jackets on a mottled purple-teal backdrop; and the steel claw hammer with a black rubber grip.

ui.fixes: The three app screens, flat and full-size with exact copy, generic black-and-white style; events by time in ui.json.

ui_endcard.fixes: End-card overlay (1920x1080, transparent): logo box, 'Visit {URL}', two legal lines at their exact sizes and positions.

score.fixes: Music + effects + room tone, voices removed; cut to 30 s and 15 s on bar starts.

arc.hook: 0.00-3.84: arrival. Mother and daughter at the door, 'I finally get to see your new place.' / 'Ta-da!'
arc.problem: 3.84-13.85: the bare room. Reverse wide of the gloomy dorm ('Not what I was expecting.'), the daughter's 'It's a vibe.', the flickering lamp, 'And you're sleeping here?', and the lamp dies: the music stops dead on the bar (13.26) for 1.5 s of silence.
arc.turn: 13.85-16.14: '{BRAND}?' / '{BRAND}.' - the music slams back in on the downbeat (14.91) with the mother's answer; she pulls out her phone.
arc.proof: 16.14-20.98: the order on the phone (product -> bag -> pick up) under the announcer ('...the ease and convenience of {BRAND}.'), whip into the photo being hung.
arc.payoff: 20.98-24.15: same wide, same camera, the room is transformed. 'Mom,' / 'It's a great photo.' and the mother's victory knocks with the hammer.
arc.end_card: 24.15-30.00: the made-over wide holds; the announcer's call to action; logo and URL arrive at 26.13-26.38 and hold.
